incarnation: Iron Tempest — current selected Anton Rook individual V2 original-project portrait2026
sourceLimits: The selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait agree; this individual V2 bitmap is one internal original-project authority, not an external franchise source.
One view establishes visible face, beard, shoulder, apron and cannon surfaces. Exact reverse-side fittings, tiny engravings and hidden finger contact surfaces are not independently established.
Iron Tempest compositions use riveted industrial architecture, steam trains, copper and steel; all new settings are original compatible scenes, not official screenshots.
CG05 is explicitly a Nexus gameplay adaptation. CG09–11 are family-safe Fan Art. CG12–15 are What If; CG13 is the one gender alternative and CG15 one hypothetical experienced future.

The source is adult-presenting without asserting a numeric age. CG13 intentionally changes gender presentation and omits the beard only for that alternate interpretation; all other character slots preserve the full source beard.
Old atlas actually opened: coat with red lining, smaller beard/stubble and no rotary rivet cannon or long brown apron; preserve it unchanged as a historical variant.
